record.dic_text:
4565 Saron {sar'-one}

源自希伯來文 SNH08289; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Saron 1; 1

沙崙 = "平的或平坦的"
1) 從巴勒斯坦的該撒利亞直到約帕的平坦區域,
   好牧草豐盛, 且以肥沃而出名 （#徒9:35|）
record.edic_text:
4565 Saron {sar'-one}

of Hebrew origin 08289;; n pr loc

AV - Saron 1; 1

Sharon = "plain or level"
1) a level region extending from Caesarea of Palestine as far as
   Joppa, abounding in good pasture and famous for its fertility
